text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Reporter Otonashi's article on me was surprisingly well received!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Wow, so this is the kind of regimen <chrname> does with her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: I heard all those rumors about excessively brutal training, but this paints a whole different picture.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the article makes the rounds, those strange rumors about me gradually begin to fade away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The days <chrname> and I spent with Reporter Otonashi are over in what feels like the blink of an eye…

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Working late again? Are you thinking about your race agenda?
choice_data_list: I see you're still at it as well.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Yes, I do this because I love it. That said, I'm not here today to get my usual coverage on you.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I've just now received word—you've been selected to participate in the Twinkle Star Climax.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: You finally did it! So, how does it feel?!
choice_data_list: I had faith that we'd make it in.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Oh? I like the confidence! I take it you won't relinquish the title of "greatest" to anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I'd like to take this opportunity to snap a photo of you. How about one down by the training track?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Great! That was perfect, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: We certainly made the most of the empty track.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I managed to get a rare shot of a trainer running down it at full speed!
choice_data_list: I actually got pretty flustered when you suddenly started running alongside me.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I figured that was the best way to imbue the image with a sense of realism. Phew… I can't remember the last time I ran that hard.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You think so?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: …I've finished my reporting for the day, so what do you say to a casual chat?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Let's admire the scenery of the track…

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: While we go for a light run!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We do as she proposes and continue our talk while jogging around the track.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: You know how you complimented my speed back there? Well, back in the countryside, I was known for being fast.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I was quite proud of my speed when I was a child. But one day…

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume transferred into my class.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: It goes without saying, but she was incredibly fast! The gap between us was such that I had no hope of even touching her tail.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: So I quit track and field. The very idea of a human winning against an Umamusume was absurd!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Reporter Otonashi rapidly picks up speed. It takes everything I have to keep up with her!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: If I couldn't compete with her, I wanted to see her crowned as the greatest! That was the selfish dream I clung to!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: She was truly incredible! It may have been a children's racing club, but she still finished in first place over and over!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: But then! Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After crossing the finish line, Reporter Otonashi suddenly comes to a stop.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: …She lost in a major race. And because of that, everyone refused to acknowledge that she was the best runner in the club.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Her destiny changed that day. She possessed real ability, and in terms of both talent and results, she was probably the club's very best…

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: But in the end, she decided to quit racing… It happens a lot, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Yes. A single defeat can decide one's fate. It can forever close off a path that was once open to you.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: But even now, I… I can't help but believe that she was the fastest runner in the entire world.
choice_data_list: So that's why you created the new race series?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I suppose so… Though, that's not the only reason, of course.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I think it's because of her that I'm using my position as a reporter to show the world my definition of the "greatest."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I want as many people as possible to see it—the moment a truly talented Umamusume proves her strength.
choice_data_list: That's why you want to attract a huge number of spectators.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Right. I couldn't realize my childhood dream…

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: But the Twinkle Star Climax is my other dream.
choice_data_list: I'm sure this will be an amazing race series.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I think so, too! Especially now that I know what you'll be bringing to it.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Once again, congratulations on making it in. I'm so excited it almost feels like I'm the one who's going to be racing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day when the "greatest" will be decided is quickly approaching. <chrname> and I have come this far…
choice_data_list: (I wonder if we can achieve our dream.)
(I wonder if we can achieve our dream.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our dream was born the day I promised I'd run alongside <chrname>. There's no turning back now.
